title: Notification regarding to designate the Secretary of each District Legal Service Authority (DLSA) as Member Secretary of District Execution Cell.
text:
KEY LINES:
order dated 15.10.2026 passed by the Hon’ble Supreme Court in M.A. Nos. 1889–] 891 of 2025

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 3“1 November, 2026
No. HCM/Misc./89-Estt(VV : in compliance with the
order dated 15.10.2026 passed by the Hon’ble Supreme Court in M.A. Nos. 1889–] 891 of 2025
in Civil Appeal Nos. 3640–3642 of 2025, Periyammat (Dead through LR„s) & Ors. v. K
Raj armani & Jnr. , and in order to facilitate expeditious execution of decrees, the Hon’ble Chief
Justice is pleased to designate the Secretary of each District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).
as Member Secretary of District Execution Cell of respective district. as an interim measure.
The District Execution Cells shall perform the following functions:
I. Monitor affidavits of assets filed by judgment-debtors pursuant to directions of
Executing Courts under Order XXI Rule 41 (2) of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
in Form No. 16A of Appendix E.
2. Prepare an execution plan. modelled on Schedule XVI of Draft Commercial Court
Rules, 2021, identifying assets of judgment-debtor and specifying proposed steps for
attachment and execution, along with timelines for each step, and place the plan
immediately before the concerned Executing Court.
3. Assist the Executing Courts in resolving bottlenecks arising in execution proceedings,
particularly in relation to attachment and sale of properties and enforcement ofdisbursal
of amounts held by banks or tlnancial institutions.
The Executing Courts shall consider the execution plans submitted by the respective Cells and
pass appropriate orders for attachment and execution. The Cells shall function in aid of the
Executing Courts and shall not exercise any independent judicial power.
By orders etc.,
Sd/-
(OJESH MUTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Imphal, the 3rd November, 2026Endt. No HCM/Misc./89-Esa(V)/ 23403 64 )
